system.description:
You release a burst of unstable, half-controlled magic at a point you can see. Roll a d6 to determine the damage type at random: fire, cold, lightning, acid, thunder, or force. Each creature within a 15-foot radius takes damage of that type.

Scaling: At dice count 3, the radius increases to 20 feet. At dice count 6, roll twice on the damage type table and apply both. At dice count 9, the damage increases substantially. At dice count 12, the surge ignores resistance to the chosen damage type. At dice count 15, the surge deals damage of all six types simultaneously.
